snippet.title: Horror-themed, School-style Action Puzzle Game “Water of M” is available on Steam.#games  #WaterofM
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360340/
Game Name: Water of M

You will uncover the secrets hidden in this school — a psychic research institute? Water of Mortal, a forbidden liquid of immortality? Solve puzzles, escape pursuit, and reveal the truth behind it all. A short but intense psychological horror adventure awaits.
